messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated 5xx and high p95 latency observed in eu-west-2 region for Hosted API and Dedicated pools. Source: auth provider errors (502/503) reported from region. Pager triggered.

mike: acked, i'm oncall. confirm impact? which endpoints most affected?

cheng: we're seeing a spike in upstream 502s from auth-proxy in eu-west-2 starting ~1749122000. Token exchange failing causing downstream 5xx on /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

irene: adding runtime view — KV cache hit rate dropped ~70% for that region, requests trying to re-auth and hitting third-party.

sam: triage note: support seeing customer reports of timeouts and 502s, some customers on Dedicated pools in eu-west-2.

mike: ok immediate actions: 1) enable regional fallback routing to eu-west-1 for new requests, 2) throttle retries on auth path to reduce fanout, 3) enable token-cache-only mode for Dedicated pools. who's owning each?

cheng: i'll flip fallback routing in traffic-router (runbook step 3). command: `curl -X POST https://traffic-router/api/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"from":"eu-west-2","to":"eu-west-1","reason":"auth-outage"}'` 

irene: i'll push token-cache-only on runtime for Dedicated eu-west-2: `redwoodctl runtime config set --region eu-west-2 --token_policy cache-only` — this stops re-exchange attempts while tokens still valid.

sam: i'll draft CS note and start collecting affected customer list, severity, and any ongoing paid contracts in region.

alice: product: prepare a short status blurb for status.redwood.com and the customer portal. Include mitigations and ETA.

aws-status-bot: AWS reported increased error rates in eu-west-2 for API Gateway and Cognito in the last 10m: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/12345 (monitoring).

mike: good. Cheng, after fallback routing is live, can we route only non-authenticated traffic first? we should avoid routing new auth flows until upstream stable.

cheng: yes — will set routing policy to `prefer: eu-west-1` but keep existing sticky sessions for already-authenticated flows. executing now.

incident-bot: ACTIONS TAKEN: fallback routing enabled at 1749123800, token-cache-only enabled at 1749124020.

irene: runtime metrics: CPU/GPUs stable, but request 5xx from auth path dropped ~45% post-routing. latency p95 remains elevated for a subset of clients due to in-flight retries.

mike: next: open ticket with AWS support (ch-9876), escalate to their Cognito/API Gateway team. Sam, please attach customer traces + example request ids.

sam: opened support case ch-9876 with logs and request ids (attached in ticket). Created internal incident doc: https://confluence/reports/INC-1749123456 (brief).

alice: what customer impact wording? suggestion: "We are seeing elevated errors and latencies in eu-west-2 caused by an external auth provider outage. Our mitigations include routing traffic to alternate region, reducing retries, and maintaining service availability. Some dedicated pools in eu-west-2 may see degraded throughput. We're working with AWS and will update in 30m."

mike: +1. Post update to status page now. sam, ping customers with active SLAs after 30m if still impacted.

cheng: continuing to monitor. If AWS doesn't resolve within 45m we'll start traffic drain of critical Dedicated pools and failover to backup pools (runbook: dedicated-failover).

incident-bot: ALERT — new spike at 1749126600 in auth 502s after short recovery. Recommendation: consider rate-limiting non-essential background jobs to reduce pressure.

irene: spun up auxiliary auth-proxy instances in eu-west-2 as band-aid (warmed but not ideal). will keep fallback active.

mike: decision: keep fallback for new sessions, limit retries, notify customers, continue escalation. oncall rotation: cheng will stay primary for next 60m, mike remains incident lead for comms.

sam: support update posted. linking customers with logs + temporary mitigation steps.

alice: product update posted to status page and portal at 1749127000.

mike: thanks all. we'll do a post-incident review after full resolution. marking this thread for handoff to follow-up doc.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED — status: partial mitigation applied. Next update scheduled in 30m or on AWS status change.
